issue.title: Ardupilot and MAVSDK compatability
issue.body:
# Bug report

Greetings. I am trying to communicate with ArduCopter firmware via MAVSDK, and i found out a few problems. Some of them already discussed in #1990 issue.

**Issue details**

1. action.takeoff() implementation for apm - [takeoff_async_apm](https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/blob/ab24200b9df9176890ec5e80c332708ba72d2a59/src/mavsdk/plugins/action/action_impl.cpp#L387)  function works only if vehicle is not in offboard mode. This is kinda strange behaviour. e.g. User might change mode to offboard via rc controller and then want to takeoff, but in this case command would not be sent.
Probably there is missing else branch.

2. Another strange thing, not a bug, but misleading behavior is telemetry.set_rate_battery(). This function sets MAVLINK_MSG_ID_SYS_STATUS, which is used not only for battery, but for health status primarily. Probably this function should be called set_rate_sys_status()? And for battery rate MAVSDK should implement set_rate_battery(), which sets [BATTERY_STATUS](https://mavlink.io/en/messages/common.html#BATTERY_STATUS) rate?

comments.body:
Hi @41Mo, thanks for the notes.

1. This was added by @ykhedar. Let's see if he can explain why it's done that way. I don't have insight into it.
2. That's indeed misleading. Especially now that we also parse the proper battery status message, as far as I remember, so we could fix this now properly. Would you mind creating a pull request to fix it?
Hi @41Mo Good catch regarding point 1. It is indeed missing the else block. Do you want to create a PR for this? Otherwise, I can do that in a few days.
@julianoes I will be happy to do pr on 2 issue.

> # Bug report
> Greetings. I am trying to communicate with ArduCopter firmware via MAVSDK, and i found out a few problems. Some of them already discussed in #1990 issue.
> 

@41Mo Have you successfully [get more actions working with Arducopter](https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK-Python/issues/453#issuecomment-1775691322)? does the [set_rate_battery helps](http://mavsdk-python-docs.s3-website.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/plugins/telemetry.html#mavsdk.telemetry.Telemetry.set_rate_battery)? if yes, what value (hz) do you use?

Nevermind, I got it working on Pi4B.
Both sub-issues appear fixed: (1) the missing else branch in takeoff_async_apm was fixed in PR #2212, (2) set_rate_battery now correctly uses MAVLINK_MSG_ID_BATTERY_STATUS. Can this be closed?
I'm sure there are more, so I'd be inclined to leave this open as a catch all.

issue.title: add telemetry set_rate_sys_status()

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
This pr implements the set_rate_sys_status() function and changes the message sent by the set_rate_battery() function to MSG_ID_BATTERY. 

Previously, the MSG_ID_SYS_STATUS rate was set using the set_rate_battery() function, which can be misleading, this was described in issue #1996.

issue.title: Telemetry rates: set_rate_rc unsupported

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
On Ardupilot, I need to set the telemetry rates myself or I don't get any updates. This works for battery and GPS, for instance.

set_rate_rc is not implemented, I guess because it is already sent with system status. However I don't get any updates there unless I open QGroundControl and then come back to my app.

I guess this is more of a list of questions:

- How does a GCS make the rc connection status start working?
- How do I get the connection strength percentage? It is always NaN
- I don't really want to change the rates that are configured in parameters on the autopilot. Is there a way to set the rate to the value configured on the autopilot? Or do I need to fetch the parameter and then set it to that value with set_rate_* ? In that case, how do I know which parameter to check (i.e. which telemetry port: for ArduPilot x in SRx_*)?

I'm sure there are more, so I'd be inclined to leave this open as a catch all.
